en.text:
Grants additional Super Energy on Kills (by either you or allies) while inside your <solar/>Well of Radiance and below 50% Super Energy.

Amount of Super Energy gained is decreased by 1.5% for each successive Kill, down to a minimum of 4% Super Energy per Kill:
10% 🠚 8.5% 🠚 7% 🠚 5.5% 🠚 4% 🠚 4% ...
